# pve_sdn_prefix_list_entry (Resource)

One permit/deny entry of an FRR prefix list; url_seq identifies the entry inside the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_prefix_list_entry" "example" {
action = "permit"
item_id = "CHANGE_ME"
prefix = "CHANGE_ME"
url_seq = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) One of: `permit`, `deny`.
- `item_id` (String) The SDN prefix list identifier
- `prefix` (String) <string>
- `url_seq` (Number) Path parameter "url_seq".

### Optional

- `delete` (List of String) <array>
- `ge` (Number) <integer> (0 - 128)
- `le` (Number) <integer> (0 - 128)
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `seq` (Number) <integer> (1 - 4294967295)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id/url_seq (also the `terraform import` format).
